title: RAMA Evaluation on rel-trial (study-outcome + study-adverse) with rel-ratebeer Backup
summary: Demo notebook for RAMA (Rank-Aware Moment Aggregation) evaluation on 2 RelBench entity tasks: study-outcome (classification, AP) and study-adverse (regression, MAE). Demonstrates: (1) the RAMA aggregation module with gated variance injection controlled by spectral rank and FK cardinality, implemented in pure PyTorch; (2) unit tests verifying shape correctness, zero-init behavior, gradient flow, edge cases, and gate diagnostics on synthetic data; (3) paired Cohen's d statistical analysis reproduced from pre-computed experiment results (baseline_mean vs RAMA, 5 seeds); (4) visualization comparing per-seed metrics and effect sizes with 95% CI. Data: 9 examples across 3 datasets from the original experiment output, plus full statistical analysis metadata.
